plain: A small country ruled by a prince

more.text: A prince; one invested with sovereignty.
The territory of a prince; or the country which gives title to a prince; as the principality of Wales.
In Scripture, royal state or attire.

example.quote: But in general, the power of the barons triumphed over that of the prince; and in many instances his dominion was entirely thrown off, and the great fiefs were erected into independent principalities or States.
